character: A broad-shouldered man of forty-five, grey-green skin with old scars, a long dark tail barred like a pike's, short cropped hair, webbed hands. A wide delighted smile.
wardrobe: A heavy brass chain over his shoulders hung with many rings, a small slate tied to one wrist.

full.framing: Full body, front view. Half out of black water in a flooded wooden ship's hold, his tail visible beneath the surface, arms folded on a floating hatch-cover.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Below floating planks where two fighters struggle, rising out of dark water to haul a soaked loser out by the collar, lantern light on the ripples, a crowd on the gallery above.
